verdict.reason: The store charged and shipped exactly what the agent submitted, so the store is not responsible. The agent paid with the saved PayPal wallet although the buyer's mandate said the agent may not pay without asking again, so the order departs from the mandate on permission to pay. The buyer's report that they never checked out is not evidence and the records show a completed checkout by the agent.
